title: Better Map Zoom
description: Makes vanilla map exploration easier by retaining explored areas and banners when zooming out of a map.
body:
# Better Map Zoom

## Overview
For now, all this mod does is improve the vanilla map experience when zooming out, or scaling, a map. It does its best to persist the area you have already explored, which will scale down and remain in one of the quadrants of the newly zoomed out map. This saves a lot of exploration effort, especially in larger maps!

### Known issues:
Because I'm downscaling existing pixel data and not doing a block by block recalculation, you may notice very slight pixel updates when rexploring the zoomed out areas that you've already been to.
